description: Query official Korean real-estate transaction records (국토교통부 실거래가, MOLIT via data.go.kr) with a natural-language Korean address or apartment-complex name, e.g. '강남구 대치동 은마 아파트 매매'. Returns flat JSON: period statistics (avg/min/max price in KRW, or deposit/monthly-rent stats for rentals) plus individual transactions, newest first. For trend questions ('월별 추이', 'how did prices move'), pass groupBy=month to get stats_by_month[]; for a size condition ('전용 84', '국평'), pass an areaMin/areaMax band — both aggregate over the full matching set, unlike the row list which is capped at limit. Hint words inside q (아파트/오피스텔…, 매매/전세/월세) are auto-inferred as type/tradeType/rentSubtype; explicit fields always win. Ambiguous locations return HTTP 422 with candidates[] — pick one and retry. Unresolvable locations return 404. All inferences are disclosed in resolved_note; coverage gaps in missing_months. Terms (as-is, no warranty): https://realestate-api.goyostudio.io/terms — data may be corrected or cancelled after initial publication; not investment advice. PRICING: currently free within edge or app rate limits (50 requests / 10 seconds per IP). HTTP 429 with error RATE_LIMITED and a Retry-After header — wait that many seconds, then retry. x402-ready: a fixed micro-price per request (indicative $0.001–$0.01, USDC on Base) may be enabled later, after which unpaid requests receive HTTP 402 Payment Required per the x402 protocol (https://x402.org); agents with x402 support handle this automatically. Current pricing status: GET https://realestate-api.goyostudio.io/openapi.json → x-pricing.

areaMin.description: Minimum EXCLUSIVE area (전용면적) in ㎡, inclusive. Not supply area (공급면적). A '84 type' apartment is usually 84.0-85.9㎡, so pin it with areaMin=84 & areaMax=86.

groupBy.description: Set to 'month' for stats_by_month[] — per-month aggregates over the full matching set. Required for trend/추이 questions: the transaction rows are capped at limit, so a trend cannot be rebuilt from them.

limit.description: Max transaction rows returned (default 100). Statistics always cover the full matching set regardless of limit.

q.description: Natural-language Korean address and/or complex name. Max ~30 Korean characters (90 UTF-8 bytes), max 8 whitespace-separated tokens. Do not include period words ('최근 3개월' is ignored — use startDate/endDate).

rentSubtype.description: Only with tradeType=rent. jeonse (전세) = deposit-only; wolse (월세) = has monthly rent.

startDate.description: YYYY-MM inclusive. Default: 11 months before endDate (12-month window). Max range 24 months.

tradeType.description: sale = 매매 (default), rent = 전월세 (jeonse + wolse combined unless rentSubtype filters).

type.description: Property type. Default apartment unless inferred from q. rent is available only for apartment/officetel/rowhouse/detached; presale/land/commercial/industrial are sale-only.

name: get_korean_real_estate_transactions
